name: Tarrasque

traits.text: Legendary Resistance (6/Day). If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The tarrasque has Advantage on sav- ing throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reflective Carapace
traits.text: If the tarrasque is targeted by a Magic Missile spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll 1d6. On a 1–5, the tarrasque is unaf- fected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.text: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.
